edits.intent: Test whether concentrating the 12-candidate budget on residual_size, delta13 and rank across more seed families raises probe mean_abs_ic above 0.051025451145186224 and novelty above 0.5 while preserving coverage 1.0.

Test whether allocating the fixed budget to the two strongest observed transforms, residual_size and rank, across the full six-seed pool improves mechanism-diverse mean_abs_ic and reduces duplicate_rate without reducing coverage.
Test whether two explicitly enabled, correlation-diversified signed-rank crossovers raise probe mean_abs_ic above the adopted parent while increasing novelty and keeping pass_count at 12.
Test whether adding cross-sectional scale normalization extends the observed rank-operator gain into higher probe mean_abs_ic without lowering coverage or materially increasing duplicate_rate.
Test whether robust tail treatment improves probe mean_abs_ic and icir_p25 relative to the adopted parent while retaining full coverage and a non-decreasing novelty score.
